correctness.rationale: The claim is reconstructed from the complete 75-facet labeled complex. Exact F2 elimination gives ranks 14 and 74 for the edge-to-vertex and triangle-to-edge boundary maps, hence H_1 dimension 2. Exhaustion of all 455 triples finds 120 missing triangles; every boundary is nonzero and the three nonzero quotient classes occur 40 times each. A three-edge simple cycle is necessarily a triangle boundary, so this exhausts all simple systoles. The three published generators generate 180 facet-preserving permutations and give exactly two missing-triangle orbits of sizes 90 and 30 with class counts 30/30/30 and 10/10/10. The embedded verifier replays every finite step.

value.rationale: The invariant is natural for a small highly symmetric triangulation of the quaternionic spherical space: it completely classifies shortest simple representatives of all three nonzero mod-two first-homology classes and explains their distribution under the full automorphism group. The result is structural rather than a free parameter slice: every minimum-length representative is classified, and the two symmetry orbits are both homologically balanced.
